glossary.name: Snap Shots
glossary.text:
A Unit may sometimes be forced to make Snap Shots instead of a regular shooting attack. Snap Shots are resolved as a regular shooting attack, except all 'To Hit' rolls are resolved at Ballistic Skill (BS) of 1. A Snap Shots Ballistic Skill (BS) characteristic may never be modified, but re-rolls are permitted.

Snap Shots may never be taken by weapons with the Blast or Large Blast special rules.

glossary.name: Perils of the Warp
glossary.text:
If a unit with this special rule, when performing its Leadership Test rolls a double 6 or a double 1, suffers a Peril of the Warp and it must immediately roll on the following Perils table after resolving its Psychic Power/Weapon.

D6	Result
1	Nothing happens…. For now.
2	The Psyker takes 1 automatic wound with no saves allowed.
3	The Psyker takes D3 automatic wounds with no saves.
4	The Psyker cannot cast anymore powers in this Shooting Phase.
5	The Psyker is empowered and gains +1 to its Strength and Toughness until the end of the round.
6	The Psyker is pulled into the warp and killed. The Psyker is killed instantly and is slain. Remove them from the board.

glossary.name: Night Fighting
glossary.text:
No unit on the battlefield is considered visible for the purposes of shooting attacks unless they are within 18" during Night Fighting. When a Mission contains this rule, before deployment each player rolls 1d6. Add the results together and consult the table below:

Total	Result
2-4	Dawn
5-9	Day
10-12	Dusk

Dawn

This results in Night Fighting Applying in Battle Round 1 and 2 of the game.

Day

The Night Fighting Rule will not be used.

Dusk

The Night Fighting Rule will be used in Battle Round 4 and 5 (and beyond if needed) of the game.
